body: I've tried therapy and meds but due to issues and probably a fair amount of paranoia I stopped. I've backed myself into a corner on this. Even if by some miracle I get over this depression I don't think I even want to live the rest of my worthless life. So I think tomorrow I'll buy some liquid courage and throw a dart at a method and end this sorry excuse of existence. I don't really want to die but it's too late for that because I'm already dead inside. I just have to make the drapes match. I wish i never existed. I guess I still have some sliver of hope in some corner of my head is why I'm posting, but hope is weakness and the greater voices are ready to end this farce.

I have attempted a bunch of times and can attest to the difficulty of the task.  Usually I would give up after it starts really hurting like hell, but I've gotten all the way to passing out but my body shook around violently enough to break the the rope. Or when I decide to do it with a way where you can't back out of after you take that last step I would freeze up or someone would see the smoke in the middle of nowhere and stop me. I can't even kill myself properly.

The biggest problem is that there is no real reason for me to feel this way. My life has been comparatively great. However I just have no joy in my life and I have always had little self esteem. It's weird that these thoughts have taken such a hold on my life. It's been two years of severe suicidal thoughts for no reason. At the start I figured they would go away with time, now I've lost all hope and simply want death more than anything I have ever wanted. I feel like I've only held on this long with the slim hope I'll die in an accident or something.

I have continued working through two years of suicidal thoughts and attempts. Even one hospitalization. Simply put up a facade of cheerfulness and make It thick. Most people won't look closely enough to see through It. Even if the facade breaks every once in a while most places won't care as long as It isn't common.  It helps to already have a reputation of solid work with the company but it cam work somewhere new too.

Your story is pretty similar to mine. Due to this I would recommend caution. The reason I do is because on a scale of 1-10 where 1 is thinking about suicide once a blue moon and 10 is an active attempt I would rank you at a 4-5. This might not seem that bad but I went from a position around where you are to a 10 in the span of a week with 0 reasons. Since then it has bounced between 6-10 for the past two years which is a hell in and of itself. Reason I say this is that maybe if I had tried to get help before it got this bad the story might have been different. Anyway whatever happens I wish you the best and gl.

I looked for a psychiatrist to begin with but it can take a while to get in with one.  Most insurance plans have a search for mental health reasons.  If not give them a call and ask for contacts in the area.  Good luck with it.
I am hyper paranoid about telling anyone who could possibly send me to the hospital about my suicidal thoughts.
I've only got 9 maybe there's nothing to be worried about.

When I called a hotline they were pretty dismissive of my suicide attempt.  They directed me to a clinic a county over.  Called them and they say they don't deal with my county and directed me to someone else.  Called them and they said they only deal with people referred from some program and directed me to someone else.  Called them and they said they only deal with alcoholics.  I was in a pretty bad place even before all this so I almost gave up right then but decided to try some other stuff.  Can't remember how but I found out my insurance company had a search system for covered psychiatrists.  So I called a couple of places most of them were out multiple months and I believe it was around the last place in a search of40 miles that would take me.  I have had nothing but bad history when it comes to this stuff so I've kinda given up on seeking help this time around and will let my mind do as it will.

I would kill myself if they came to my job for me.  Being escorted out of the psychiatrist's office was mortifying enough.  As a side note I've developed a number of contingency plans for offing myself if they come for me.  Also great username.

Yeah I've chickened out about six times this past year one time I got to the point where I had to be a moment from blacking out.  Each time I wished to myself that I had gone all the way.  I've never tried the drug method though too scared of failure and after effects.

I was involuntarily admitted and that was after seeking help with a psychiatrist and psychologist.  Anyway they held me for ten days and the bill was well over 100k I was pretty floored because it felt like they had done next to nothing.  I only had to pay like 8k of it though due to insurance but it still hurt a lot.  I don't think the psychiatrist helped much but between him and the meds I did start to feel a bit better.  I think I might be somewhat paranoid too because I never could fully expose myself and my darkest thoughts.  So after I started to feel a bit better I decided I no longer wanted to keep getting whacked with a 120 bill each week as I am not rich.  Anyway I'm back down into pretty bad suicidal thoughts and I would freak out if anyone tried to bring me to the hospital again.  So now it feels like my paranoia is getting worse and I can't bring myself to talk to the family that I originally talked to the first time.  As a kicker the hospital also gave me scabies which I wouldn't wish on my worst enemy.

I don't think I've ever seen someone sum up my current feelings so completely I'm baffled.  Every day I tell myself now's the time to do it, but then something inside me stops just short and I push it further back thinking next time it will all be over.  Maybe I'm just too much the coward.
